bibl.title: Three Coptic letters in the Museum Gustavianum.
bibl.seg: Åke Engsheden & Andreas Winkler, Three Coptic letters in the Museum Gustavianum.
bibl.note: Coptic ostraca from the Egyptian collection in the Museum, Uppsala, wich encompasses the Victoriamuseet för ergyptiska fornsaker (Victoria Museum of Egyptian Antiquities). - 1. Inv. 1085. Letter from Elias to Samuel. Thebaid, early 7th cent. - 2. Inv. 1487. Letter about the appointment of a shepherd. Thebaid, early 7th cent. - 3. Inv. 2397. Letter about a delivery. Probably Thebaid, 6th-8th cent.
